html: Every primer and plan now ends with a control to mark it complete — nothing is inferred from how far you scrolled, so it only counts when you say so. Completed items show the date in the sidebar, and you can undo it whenever you like.

Accounts arrived: sign in to keep your place across devices. New privacy & cookies and terms of use pages set out exactly what is stored and why, and why sign up compares an account with browsing as a guest. Account holders can now opt in to hear when new skills or features land.
Strategic Synthesis & Decision-Making added as a new Future Skill, with a primer and full learning plan.
Dark Mode added — toggle light/dark appearance from the nav
Systems Thinking added as a new Future Skill, with a primer and full learning plan. Announcement banner added to the homepage for surfacing time-sensitive updates.
Search now indexes individual News stories, not just the News page, and supports extended search with a range of search term operators.
News section added — a curated, dated feed of workforce and skills stories.
